study.question: Does a tied nonlinear logit difference, anchored at the global pooled summary, expose incremental target-query utility after preventing an independent additive feature-only head? Compare target versus history-mean queries and both frozen source bests, especially the stronger pooled controls.
study.hypothesis: Observation: centered_target AUC 0.6304555845 exceeds centered_context 0.6302771484 and centered_null 0.6303864702, but remains below pooled_reference 0.6307714975; target Logloss 0.1926526373 also exceeds null 0.1926389704. Candidate-supplied correction RMS 0.836 and checkpoint logit shift 0.0386 show implementation activity, not utility. Empirical priors previously gave target/context AUC 0.6303523996/0.6303489998, and radius_target 0.6306798923 remained below the stronger pooled control. Provisional mechanism: an unconstrained extra head over all inherited features may spend capacity relearning pooled evidence instead of learning the attention correction. Test parent + h(X,p+d)-h(X,p), using exactly the inherited head twice with tied weights. This removes the independent h(X,p) shortcut. If useful target-specific corrections exist, the target version may improve over the history-query replacement and pooled references. This is an untested explanation, not evidence that shortcut learning caused prior failures.

nearest_work.difference: Inherit ad-conditioned local scoring and weighted history aggregation. DIN explicitly abandons softmax; this study keeps the inherited balanced group softmax and signed weight centering. New local intervention is tied predictor subtraction, not DIN replication or a verified general novelty claim.
Preserve all source classes and _centered_read. Replace only additive h(X,p+d) by h(X,p+d)-h(X,p); reuse the same head with no allocation, new inputs, fitted scale or extra randomness.

This strongest observed utility control uses only a global pooled summary in its extra head. Preserve it as a historical performance/cost reference. Its trained result is not an independently retrained matched null for the new contrast.
Respect category/brand/type fields without inventing item identities. Publisher paper unavailable; no detailed DMR mechanism or priority claim.

inherited_components: Host-owned data construction, scoring, resource ledger and frozen information boundary; no raw-data access or local training
Full g1-r0019-pooled_observed predictor and all identity/context/repeat/overlap/transition/gap heads
g3-r0022-centered_target balanced within-match-group signed correction d=sum((w-u)*value), with separate field reads
Same dormant-parent attention activated as scorer, embeddings, head allocation order, initialization and training recipe

study.proposed_difference: Only the readout-to-logit map changes: with inherited bias-free W,V and ReLU, a=W[X,p], b=W_summary*d, return parent+V(ReLU(a+b)-ReLU(a)). In real arithmetic this is h(X,p+d)-h(X,p), with shared weights, identical allocated parameter count 17,270,691 in the frozen metadata, and exactly zero residual for d=0. Both query modes execute the same graph. Neither input nor logits are detached. This differs from input centering: the preceding study centered weights but still retained independent h(X,p) capacity. The new head retains conditional interactions with X; it does not remove all extra function capacity. General novelty remains unverified.
predictions: Algebraic: null correction d=0 gives exactly zero residual for every X,p and parameter setting; empty histories also yield zero new residual. Explicit two-head and efficient preactivation implementations agree within float32 tolerance; inherited parent reproduction remains within 1e-5 on the fixed probe.

Empirical, uncertain: tied_target exceeds tied_context and both frozen source bests (pooled_observed AUC 0.6302753101, balanced_target 0.6202303849), and must also exceed the stronger pooled_reference AUC 0.6307714975 before suggesting useful complementarity. Report Logloss separately.

The tied contrast should have the same allocated and active head/scorer capacity in target/context variants, with training/inference cost close to centered variants; the narrow W_summary*d product adds compute but no parameters. All host cost measurements are decisive.

Predeclared descriptive slices use host bins/counts for history length, hour, action presence, match presence and training frequency. In particular history>64 has 3,026,583 validation rows/151,372 positives; empty has 8,272/310. Examine heterogeneity without selecting by slice maxima or claiming confirmatory significance.
falsifiers: Target fails to exceed strongest pooled_reference or the target-query replacement; a positive diagnostic or improvement over only the weaker source does not establish complementarity.
Logloss deterioration, excessive measured inference/training cost, or an advantage explained by a historical duplicate-evidence control prevents an unqualified performance claim.

Nonzero null residual, discrepancy from explicit tied-head oracle beyond normal float32 error, nonfinite empty/zero-length outputs, or order/padding errors invalidate the implementation before mechanism interpretation.
A single-seed ordering is not repeated support; if later paired seeds reverse it, retain an inconclusive outcome. No test feedback is available or authorized.
alternative_explanations: Across nominal pooled nulls AUC ranges from empirical_uniform 0.6300724490 to pooled_reference 0.6307714975 despite near-equal checkpoint algebra. Finite-precision computation, optimization trajectories, allocation-dependent RNG effects or winner selection remain unseparated; no single explanation is established.
Tied subtraction can reduce useful additive capacity or change optimization/regularization. Failure would reject this implementation, not all target conditioning.
Context replaces only the query with a history-field mean. Match partitions, static features and the full predictor still use the target, so this does not test total target independence.

Shared head cancellation eliminates a standalone pooled term but leaves additional nonlinear interactions. Historical duplicate/capacity controls are useful utility anchors, not fresh causal controls for this map. A winning target still needs a newly trained active duplicate-evidence replacement and paired repetitions.

Static publisher snapshots have undocumented as-of dates; this remains a benchmark assumption. Category/brand histories are coarser than item sequences; no transfer from external conversion studies is established.
First-512 candidate diagnostics establish local code properties only; no labels, population generalization or causal interpretation follows.
